prompt:
Flat front-on UI design comp of a landscape 16:9 desktop web app screen: the PLAY SCREEN of "Neckspert Play" during a series, read from 1 metre by a guitarist whose hands are on the guitar. Keep the pixel-art system grammar of the reference image exactly (8x8 tile grid, 8x8 pixel cap font, crisp square pixels, hierarchy by border boxes and inversion, checkerboard dither) and its four-tone palette; change the COMPOSITION.

Structure, in order:
1. Flat matte near-black letterbox bands left and right; centred, one game frame with a 10:9 ratio (160x144 logical pixels, slightly wider than tall), integer-scaled, filling nearly the full viewport height.
2. Inside the frame, top two thirds: the consigne. A giant blocky pixel letter "F" built from whole tiles on the left half, with a one-tile drop shadow; to its right, stacked, "corde de B" in the pixel font at double scale. Plain ground behind, no dither band.
3. Inside the frame, bottom third: the TIME LANE, the one dominant signature move. A horizontal lane of square tiles, one tile per beat, two bars of four beats (8 tiles) plus the target tile, scrolling from right to left toward a vertical hit line near the left edge of the lane drawn as a thick double pixel rule. Tiles already passed are dithered; the current beat tile is inverted (solid dark); beat numbers 1 2 3 4 1 2 3 4 in tiny pixel digits above the tiles; bar separators as taller tick marks. At the far right end of the lane the target tile carries a small pixel note sprite and the letter F, arriving on the hit line two bars later. A tiny pixel heart sprite sits on the hit line.
4. Under the lane, one thin line of pixel text: "MESURE 2/2  TEMPS 3/4".
No verdict box in this state (the note has not been played yet).

Palette strictly four flat tones inside the frame: ground #E99568 peach-amber, midtone #BE6754, shade #813B2A, ink #451218 deep oxblood; outside the frame flat #1E1B1B. Text exactly and only: "F", "corde de B", "1 2 3 4 1 2 3 4", "MESURE 2/2  TEMPS 3/4". French interface. No navigation, no logo, no score, no XP, no streaks, no guitar imagery, no wood, no strings, no drawn fretboard, no neon glow, no CRT scanlines, no gradients.
Reference image: .impeccable/mocks/decision/challenger-gameboy-bonfire.png. Post-process: colours snapped to the measured Bonfire palette with .impeccable/tools/recolor.py.
